name: tennis-matches
description: Tennis players find someone to play a match with, for no money.

description.description: The match the player wants to play.

place.description: Where to play: a court, or anywhere in the circle the player will go.

time.description: When to play: a time, or a span when the player is free.

court.description: Whether a court is booked, and any fee to share.

showedUp.description: Whether the player came to the match as agreed.

level.description: The level the reviewer would put the player at.
